maya: Maya arrives on an empty city rooftop at sunset, stretches to warm up, breakdances while the city lights come on, then sits on the ledge drinking water and looking at the skyline at night.
theo: Theo bakes a birthday cake for a friend: he reads a recipe in a sunny kitchen, cracks eggs into a bowl, takes the finished cake out of the oven, and carries it with lit candles into a dark living room where his friend waits.
yuki: On a rainy night Yuki runs through a neon-lit alley holding a red umbrella in one hand and a paper lantern in the other, jumps over a puddle, loses the umbrella to the wind, and finally shelters under a shrine gate, soaked but laughing.
